message.content: {"output_action": "CREATE", "skill_draft": {"name": "prioritize_report_generator_for_laterality_assessment", "description": "When diagnosing conditions involving anatomical laterality or spatial orientation (e.g., situs inversus, dextrocardia), prioritize the report generator over the classifier to capture structural landmark positions.", "applicable_conditions": "Tasks requiring determination of left-right anatomical orientation, mirror-image anatomy, or spatial positioning of internal organs where normalized pathology scores are insufficient.", "branch": "task_level", "tool_name": null, "task_category": ["medical_imaging_interpretation"], "required_tools": ["chest_xray_report_generator"], "risk_level": "high", "core_action": "If the diagnostic task involves determining anatomical laterality (e.g., heart apex position, liver/stomach side): (1) Do NOT rely solely on `chest_xray_classifier` outputs, as they lack spatial orientation data; (2) Call `chest_xray_report_generator` to obtain descriptive text regarding structural landmarks and their relative positions; (3) Extract laterality information from the generated report to confirm or rule out conditions like situs inversus."}, "patch_target_id": null, "patch_section": null, "patch_content": null}
